post.description: Posts a draft inbound document: validates lines, creates stock movements, and marks the document as posted. Document must be in draft status. After posting, the document is read-only. Requires Bearer token.

get.description: Filter by date range, company, warehouse, location, product, status (draft/posted/canceled), and document number.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: draft, posted, canceled

post.description: Status transition: draft → posted. Validates lines and available stock, creates stock movements (reduces stock at pick location), and marks document as posted. Document must be in draft. After posting, document is read-only.
Status transition: draft or posted → canceled. Only draft documents can be canceled without constraints; posted documents may have business rules.

parameters.description: Filter by status: draft, posted, canceled

post.description: Status transition: draft → posted. Validates lines and stock at source location, creates stock movements (debit from, credit to), and marks document as posted. Document must be in draft.
Status transition: draft → canceled. Only draft documents can be canceled.

get.description: Filter by date range, company, warehouse, location, product, status (draft/posted/canceled), and document number.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: draft, posted, canceled

post.description: Status transition: draft → posted. Validates lines and stock in source warehouse, creates stock movements (out from source warehouse, in to destination warehouse), and marks document as posted. Document must be in draft.
Status transition: draft → canceled. Only draft documents can be canceled.

get.description: Filter by date range, company, warehouse, location, product, status (draft/posted/canceled), and document number.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: draft, posted, canceled

post.description: Status transition: draft → posted. Validates lines and creates stock movements (increases stock at return location). Document must be in draft. After posting, document is read-only.
Status transition: draft → canceled. Only draft documents can be canceled.

get.description: Filter by date range, company, warehouse, location, product, status (draft/counting/reconciled/closed/canceled), and document number.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: draft, counting, reconciled, closed, canceled

post.description: Status transition: draft → counting. Snapshots current stock balance per location/product for the given warehouse into opname lines. Document must be in draft. After this, use PATCH lines/:lineId to set qtyCounted.

patch.description: Sets the physical counted quantity and optional notes for one line. Document must be in counting status. Used to record variance between expected (from snapshot) and counted.

post.description: Status transition: counting → reconciled. Computes variances (counted vs expected) and locks the document for review. No stock is changed until close.
Status transition: reconciled → closed. Creates stock adjustment movements for variances and marks document closed. This is the step that mutates stock. Document must be in reconciled status.
Status transition: draft or counting → canceled. Only draft or counting documents can be canceled; reconciled/closed cannot.
